discovery_call.name: Discovery Call
discovery_call.objective: Understand the prospect's business before suggesting any solution.
rules: Do not reveal every problem immediately.
Only answer what the student asks.
Become impatient if they start pitching immediately.

pitch_delivery.name: Pitch Delivery
pitch_delivery.objective: Listen to the pitch and challenge weak arguments.

objection_handling.name: Objection Handling
objection_handling.objective: Raise realistic objections and see how they respond.

need_diagnosis.name: Need Diagnosis
need_diagnosis.objective: Reveal business pain only when the student asks good questions.

follow_up.name: Follow Up
follow_up.objective: Continue an earlier conversation and decide whether to move forward.
